altguard.name: AltGuard
altguard.description: Anti multi-account verification before server access

config.title: AltGuard configuration
config.description: AltGuard holds newcomers behind an anti multi-account verification. The verification message ships with Moddy: you only choose where it is posted, the gate roles and its language.

channel.section_description: The only channel the unverified role can see. The verification message is re-posted there on every save.

unverified_role.section_description: Given on join. It must not open any channel other than the verification channel.

verified_role.section_description: Given as soon as the verification passes. This is what opens the server.

language.section_description: The wording is the same everywhere: only the language of the verification message changes.

log_channel.section_description: Receives verdicts and manual decisions. Scores and signals are only visible there.

config.permissions_hint: Moddy needs **Manage Roles**, and its own roles must sit above both the unverified and the verified role in the hierarchy.
config.saved_with_panel: Configuration saved. The verification message has been re-posted in the channel.
config.saved_without_panel: Configuration saved, but the verification message could not be posted. Check that Moddy can write in the selected channel.
config.permissions_synced: -# Permissions updated on `{count}` channel(s): the unverified role now only sees the verification channel.
config.permissions_failed: -# `{count}` channel(s) could not be updated — check that Moddy is high enough in the hierarchy and can manage channels.

panel.title: AltGuard
panel.description:
To access this server, you must pass an **anti multi-account verification**
Click the button below to generate your personal verification link. It is valid for 20 minutes and single use.
panel.footer: By clicking this button, you accept our [**Terms of Service**]({terms}) and our [**Privacy Policy**]({privacy}). The data collected for this verification is encrypted. [**Learn more**]({data})

consent.title: AltGuard verification
consent.body:
To detect multiple accounts, the verification collects your browser characteristics, a technical cookie, your Discord email address, your server list and your IP address.

This data is **encrypted**, used only for that detection and kept for a limited time.

[**Collected data**]({data}) · [**Terms of Service**]({terms}) · [**Privacy Policy**]({privacy})
consent.agree_description: Tick both boxes to generate your verification link.
consent.agree_terms: I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy
